meta.warmup_note: Rolling windows (21d/50d/252d) are computed with warm-up history before `report_from`; the reported series starts at report_from regardless.
meta.sector_source: data/benchmarks/ind_nifty50list.json 'sector' field, used AS-IS (GICS-style India buckets) -- NOT Rohit's ad hoc 12-name scheme. sector_name_map below gives the best-effort correspondence where one clearly exists; unmapped sectors keep the list's own name.

formulas.RealizedCorrN: mean of the off-diagonal upper-triangle entries of the NxN pairwise Pearson correlation matrix of daily log returns over the trailing N trading days (members needing >= max(5, N//3) valid obs in the window to be included that day)
formulas.CrossSectionalDispersion: population std-dev (ddof=0), across the 50 members' daily log returns, on a single day
formulas.Dispersion21/50: trailing N-day rolling mean of CrossSectionalDispersion
formulas.Dispersion21PctileXy: percentile rank of the latest Dispersion21 value within its own trailing 1y (252d) / 3y (756d) history
formulas.PctAboveNDMA: 100 * (members with level > their own trailing N-day SMA of level) / (members with both level and the N-day SMA available)
formulas.AdvDecLine: cumulative sum of (advancers - decliners) across days
formulas.NewHighs/Lows: count of members whose level today equals the trailing 252d rolling max/min of their own level series
formulas.BreadthScore: mean of (PctAbove20DMA, PctAbove50DMA, PctAbove200DMA, 100*adv/(adv+dec)) on that day, scale 0-100; any null input is dropped from the mean rather than nulling the whole score
formulas.sector_corrN/dispN: same RealizedCorrN / CrossSectionalDispersion formulas, restricted to a sector's own members (sectors with >=3 members present in this NIFTY 50 file only)
formulas.sector_breadth: PctAbove50DMA restricted to a sector's own members
formulas.sector_matrix.corrN: pairwise Pearson correlation, over the trailing N trading days ending on the last date, of each sector's own daily EQUAL-WEIGHT return series (mean of member log returns that day)

meta.not_built_this_pass: modules 1,3,5,8-16,18-21 (implied vol / options, backtests, dash UI) -- no local options/IV data source; see the brief.
